description: Change the palette and/or typography of an app created with the wizard or neblla_create_app, AFTER creation. Re-bakes only the theme tokens (--nb-bg, --nb-primary, …, --nb-font-title, --nb-font-body) in main.css and the Google Fonts link in index.html; every other line stays as the developer left it. Tokens the developer deleted are not put back: they come back in `missing`. Stores the theme on the app. The files and the theme wait in the draft until neblla_promote "publish". (neblla_update_app with `theme` only stores it, without touching the files.)

palette.description: Hex colours, e.g. { background: "#14131C", primary: "#6C8CFF", dark: true }

dark.description: true for a dark background: text and cards switch to light neutrals

name: neblla_retheme_app
title: Retheme app
